nodes.label: Python Sidecar STT Decision
nodes.rationale: STT in a Python sidecar, not in-browser whisper: transformers.js ports are slow/heavy (~1GB models, numpy). Reuses Zen's verified Jarvis pipeline. Note: this decisions doc predates the README's Web Speech API pivot.

nodes.label: Raw PCM Transcribe Contract
nodes.rationale: Raw int16 PCM over POST /transcribe, no multipart/wav — simplest contract; client decodes MediaRecorder webm to PCM and resamples to 16kHz via Web Audio AudioContext.

nodes.label: Module-Level Store Decision
nodes.rationale: useSyncExternalStore + a plain mutable module-level store, no Redux/Zustand — the laziest thing that survives reload via localStorage for a small demo.

nodes.label: Simulated WhatsApp Decision
nodes.rationale: The WhatsApp group is simulated via a 'Simulate incoming' button — live Baileys is against WhatsApp ToS and heavy for a POC; the wow is fully reproducible with one tap. Live Baileys/Cloud API noted as the production path.

nodes.label: Overlaid Toast Notification Decision
nodes.rationale: Notification as an overlaid toast inside the phone frame so the wow moment is visible over whatever screen the user is on; only the latest notification shows (queue's first item).
